# Why Faster Giving Matters: How The Blackbaud Giving Fund Helps Nonprofits Receive Donations at the Speed of Need


Print


#### [FAQs](https://blackbaudgivingfund.org/blog/category/faqs/) ,[Giving](https://blackbaudgivingfund.org/blog/category/giving/) ,[Resources](https://blackbaudgivingfund.org/blog/category/resources/)


August 18, 2026 | 7 min read By:[Catherine LaCour](https://blackbaudgivingfund.org/blog/authors/catherine-lacour/)


**Key Takeaways**


- Speed equals retention; delivering funds faster allows fundraisers to thank donors while intention is high, protecting donor retention.


- Blackbaud Verified Network helps nonprofits increase visibility to millions of potential donors.


- Faster fund delivery strengthens stewardship and donor relationships.


- Transparency is one of today’s strongest fundraising advantages.


Every day, nonprofits respond to urgent needs that cannot wait for slow funding processes. Whether they’re providing meals after a natural disaster, supporting families during a crisis, or delivering critical community services, timing matters. That’s why the infrastructure behind charitable giving matters as much as generosity itself.


At The Blackbaud Giving Fund, our role is simple but essential: we help move generosity from donors and companies to nonprofits with speed, security, and transparency so fundraising teams can maximize impact and build lasting relationships.


Because


[when donations arrive faster, nonprofits can respond faster](https://www.forbes.com/councils/forbesnonprofitcouncil/2026/07/23/the-cost-of-waiting-how-faster-funding-strengthens-nonprofit-impact/) . We call this


*giving at the speed of need* .


## **More Than Moving Money**


Many people ask, “What is The Blackbaud Giving Fund?” We’re a public charity and charitable grant-making organization that works alongside Blackbaud, a leading provider of AI-powered technology for social impact. Together, we play complementary roles.


[Blackbaud](https://blackbaud.com/) provides the technology that enables companies, employees, and individual donors to give through workplace giving, peer-to-peer fundraising, and other charitable programs.


[The Blackbaud Giving Fund](https://blackbaudgivingfund.org/) provides the trusted charitable infrastructure that receives donations, verifies nonprofit eligibility, and securely delivers grants to nonprofits around the world.


The partnership is designed to make generosity easier, faster, and more transparent for everyone involved. Today, that infrastructure helps connect nonprofits with over 9 million potential donors taking advantage of corporate social responsibility programs through Your Cause from Blackbaud, ensuring donations move from donor intention to nonprofit impact with zero friction.


## **Why Speed Matters for Donor Retention and Cash Flow**


Donors expect charitable giving to work like the rest of their digital lives. When they order a package, they can track it. When they transfer money, they know when it arrives. In 2026, donors demand that same real-time visibility and confidence when they invest in your mission.


Nonprofits benefit from those expectations, too. Visibility into faster fund delivery means they can:


- Put donations to work sooner to generate immediate, reportable impact.


- Improve donor retention by thanking donors while the giving experience is still fresh.


- Strengthen cash flow management and operational budgeting.


- Build data-backed credibility with individual supporters and corporate CSR leads.


When generosity moves efficiently, your entire fundraising strategy wins.


## **How The Blackbaud Giving Fund Moves Donations Faster**


Speed doesn’t happen by accident; it’s made possible by our expedited giving capabilities. It’s the result of purpose-built infrastructure designed to remove delays that can slow charitable giving.


With our secure infrastructure, we streamline the donation journey from the donor to the nonprofit using electronic payment methods, like ACH, which allow money to move faster than mailing a check or a credit card transaction. This purpose-built approach reduces processing time and enables nonprofits to receive funds in as little as two business days, which is up to 99% faster than traditional delivery methods.


## **Helping Nonprofits Raise More, Not Just Receive More**


Moving donations is only part of the equation. To stay competitive, nonprofits must have greater visibility into the growing


[workplace giving](https://blackbaudgivingfund.org/blog/what-is-workplace-giving-and-why-its-important-for-nonprofits/) ecosystem. That’s why


[Blackbaud Verified Network](https://www.yourcause.com/products/blackbaudverifiednetwork) is a key lynchpin in the giving equation. Blackbaud Verified Network is a free resource that helps nonprofits become more discoverable to companies, employees, and individual donors giving through Blackbaud-powered solutions.


Nonprofits that join the network can:


- Receive grants through


[ACH](https://blackbaudgivingfund.org/blog/how-to-register-for-ach-on-blackbaud-verified-network-a-step-by-step-guide/) for faster payments and a more secure cash flow.


- Build a


[trusted profile](https://blackbaudgivingfund.org/blog/getting-started-with-blackbaud-verified-network-a-simple-guide-to-setting-up-and-optimizing-your-profile/) that helps donors discover and understand their mission.


- Access reporting and donor insights to identify high-value corporate leads and individual prospects.


- Increase visibility to millions of potential donors.


- Better position themselves for workplace giving and corporate giving opportunities.


The goal isn’t simply to receive donations more efficiently. It’s to help nonprofits expand their reach and strengthen long-term fundraising strategies.


## **Building Trust Through Transparency**


Trust has always mattered in philanthropy. Today, it’s one of the biggest factors influencing whether donors choose to give. That’s why every nonprofit in the Blackbaud Verified Network undergoes verification to confirm eligibility and regulatory compliance. This diligence helps companies and donors give with confidence while helping trusted nonprofits receive grants more efficiently.


Transparency also means giving nonprofits greater visibility into their donations so they know where funds are in the process and when they can expect them. When fundraisers have better information, they can steward donors more effectively and make strategic decisions.


## **What This Means for Fundraisers**


As fundraising continues to evolve, nonprofits can think beyond individual campaigns and focus on strengthening the systems that support year-round financial resilience.


If you’re looking for a place to start, here are three actions you can take today:


1. [Claim your free Blackbaud Verified Network profile](https://blackbaudgivingfund.org/blog/getting-started-with-blackbaud-verified-network-a-simple-guide-to-setting-up-and-optimizing-your-profile/) to increase your visibility to workplace giving and corporate donors.


2. [Enroll in ACH](https://blackbaudgivingfund.org/blog/how-to-register-for-ach-on-blackbaud-verified-network-a-step-by-step-guide/) so eligible grants can be delivered electronically, helping your nonprofit access funding more quickly.


3. [Review your profile regularly](https://blackbaudgivingfund.org/blog/a-strategic-guide-to-integrating-blackbaud-verified-network-into-your-workflow/) to ensure your mission, programs, and contact information are current so donors and companies have the information they need to support your work.


Small improvements to your fundraising infrastructure can make a meaningful difference in your nonprofit’s ability to attract donors, receive funding faster, and build lasting relationships.


## **Looking Ahead**


The Blackbaud Giving Fund is committed to strengthening the infrastructure that powers generosity. That means helping nonprofits receive donations at the speed of need, giving donors confidence that their generosity is making an impact, and creating a more connected, transparent philanthropic ecosystem for everyone.


Because when we remove friction from giving, we create sustainable, predictable funding that benefits communities.


Ready to reach over 9 million potential donors and bring your fundraising strategy to the next level? Sign up for the free


[Blackbaud Verified Network](https://nonprofit.yourcause.com/login/create-account) platform and protect your competitive edge.
